app.title: Tweaker — Windows tuning
docs.title: Tweak catalog
docs.generated: Generated by build/New-TweakDocs.ps1 from config/tweaks/*.json. Do not edit by hand.
docs.legend: Risk: Safe — fine for everyone; Moderate — has trade-offs, read the description; Advanced — only if you understand the consequences. "unverified" — behaviour not confirmed on current builds; such tweaks are never part of presets.
cli.listLegend: Legend: ? - not verified on current builds, - - not supported on this Windows build.

cli.hkcuRedirect: Elevated as a different account: per-user settings will be written to the signed-in user's profile.

cli.guiUnavailable: The graphical interface is not available in this build.

dns.title: DNS servers
dns.text: Pick a network adapter and a DNS service. Previous settings are backed up.
dns.doh: DNS encryption (DoH) becomes available in Settings → Network → DNS.
dns.undoHint: To restore previous servers: the Rollback button at the top or the Automatic preset.
debloat.title: Built-in apps
debloat.text: Removed for all users and from the image for new accounts. System components, Microsoft Store, App Installer (WinGet), frameworks and Edge are protected and not listed. Removed apps can be reinstalled from Microsoft Store.
debloat.confirmText: These apps will be removed for all users. They can only be restored by reinstalling from Microsoft Store.
debloat.onedrive.title: OneDrive
debloat.onedrive.warning: Files kept online-only (Files On-Demand) become unavailable on this PC until OneDrive is reinstalled. Make sure the files you need are downloaded first.
debloat.edgeNote: Microsoft Edge and WebView2 are never removed: Windows and many apps depend on them.
apps.title: Install apps
apps.text: Apps are installed from the official WinGet repository, with no bundled offers.
apps.noWinget.title: WinGet not found
apps.noWinget.text: Installing apps needs App Installer from Microsoft Store. Install or update it, then open this page again.
cleanup.title: Disk cleanup
cleanup.text: The estimated size is shown first; after cleaning you see how much space was actually freed.
cleanup.temp.hint: %TEMP% and Windows\Temp, files older than a day.
cleanup.docache.hint: Files for sharing updates with other PCs.
cleanup.thumbcache.hint: Thumbnails are rebuilt when folders are opened.
cleanup.recyclebin.hint: Files in the Recycle Bin are deleted permanently.
cleanup.dism.hint: Removes superseded component versions. May take 5-15 minutes.
cleanup.dismresetbase.hint: Frees more space, but installed updates can no longer be uninstalled afterwards.
tools.repair.title: Windows repair
tools.repair.text: Standard Microsoft tools. Checks may take 10-30 minutes.
tools.wureset.text: Update services are stopped, SoftwareDistribution and catroot2 are renamed (not deleted), then services start again. Update history in Settings becomes empty.
tools.netreset.text: Last resort for broken networking: netsh winsock reset and netsh int ip reset. Requires a restart; some VPN and antivirus software must be reinstalled.
tools.running: Running… this may take several minutes.
tools.safety.title: Restore points and backups
tools.safety.text: A restore point is created before the first change, and every change is backed up.
tools.rpNone: No restore points (or System Protection is off).
